mechanism: Severe extratropical cyclone or derecho (wind > 50 mph) hits Mid-Atlantic
Transmission lines sag/trip in PJM region causing voltage disturbances
Data centers in Northern Virginia disconnect as controllable loads (1.5–2 GW drop)
Frequency transient triggers Under-Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS) across multiple states
Cascading reverse shedding wave propagates through Eastern Interconnection
PJM declares Level 3 Emergency; rotating outages begin
narrative_signature_forecast: Stage 2: Same event relabeled as 'planned maintenance' or 'system improvement'
Stage 3: Silence (no official explanation during/after event)
Stage 4: Collapse (observable blackout) with delayed or absent press release
kill_conditions: PJM secures emergency interregional transmission capacity
500+ MW reserve margin restored in Eastern Interconnection
falsification_criterion: No cascading multi-state blackout event with spatial specificity to Data Center Alley occurs between T_fracture and T_observable

confidence.basis: Validated against 2003 blackout, DOE 202(c) orders, 2024 data center event, transformer lead times
